about_the_game:
England, 1932. Lord Robert Anderson has died. His faithful butler has called you for help as he and your father served together in the Great War. You have left your appointment and come to his imposing mansion in the dead of night to investigate a murder. Everyone looks sad, but behind their faces there are secrets. You don't yet know who, how or why, but in 120 minutes you must discover what lies behind these people who now stare fearfully at the body of a murdered man... before Scotland Yard arrives and the truth slips through your fingers.

Clue: Murder by Death is a narrative mystery adventure set in the heart of 1930s England — a time of elegance, secrets, and deceit. When the respected Lord Anderson is found dead in his study, you are summoned to assist in the investigation. With only two hours before Scotland Yard arrives, you must explore the mansion, question its eccentric residents, and uncover the truth hidden beneath layers of lies and betrayal. Every character hides something — a forbidden affair, a secret society, or a motive for revenge. Your decisions determine who to trust, who to confront, and how the story unfolds. Can you solve the case before time runs out?

🎩 Key Features

🔹 Immersive 3D isometric world inspired by classic British mysteries.
🔹 Explore, investigate, and interrogate to piece together the truth.
🔹 Multiple endings depending on your deductions and alliances.
🔹 Each character has a distinct personality, motive, and secret.
🔹 Unique art style blending dark humor and vintage charm.
🔹 Available in English, French, Catalan, Spanish, and Italian.
🔹 Atmospheric original soundtrack enhancing every twist and revelation.

🏰 Setting

England, 1932.
A manor lost in fog and secrecy, where family honor, forbidden love, and greed collide under one roof.
Every room tells a story — and every object may hide a clue.

💀 Meet the Suspects

  • John Smith, the detective — sharp, composed, and running against time.

  • Lady Brighton, the widow — refined, manipulative, and dangerously calm.

  • James Benson, the butler — loyal servant or silent accomplice?

  • Nancy Walkers, the housekeeper — loyal to a fault… or hiding guilt?

  • David Living, the explorer — a man of science haunted by ancient myths.

🎨 Visual Style

A blend of diorama-style 3D graphics and expressive chibi characters brings the mystery to life.
Each room of the manor is richly detailed — filled with clues, hidden objects, and interactive secrets waiting to be discovered.

🧭 Gameplay

Investigate the scene, examine evidence, and connect clues to uncover motives.
Pair up with other characters, decide who to trust, and experience a branching story where every decision counts.

Inspired by Clue, Agatha Christie, and Return of the Obra Dinn, this game invites you to step inside a living mystery where wit and observation are your best allies.

🧑‍💻 Developed by

Cocodrilo Games — an independent studio crafting narrative-driven adventures filled with atmosphere, charm, and mystery.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Intel i5 (2018) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 630 / Apple M1 GPU
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires Metal support. Not compatible with macOS older than 10.15
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 / M2 or Intel i7 (2019)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD and Retina display (or 1080p) recommended

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD and Full HD resolution recommended
